messages:
sara: quick follow-up to the pinning schema RFC: proposing a 'variant-bundling' mode where the control plane groups small, compatible variant diffs into a single routing/telemetry bundle for a short window to cut churn on perf/quant-only canaries.

mike: useful for noise reduction, but how do we avoid hiding semantic changes? need a clear compatibility contract.

yun: agree. require onboarding to emit a compatibility signal (compat_eval_id + threshold). platform runs a lightweight check and emits a bundle_score. telemetry must still show per-variant traces.

kevin: schema additions idea (informal): bundle_id:string, bundle_window_days:int, bundle_policy:enum("strict","lenient"), compatibility_signal:{eval_id:string,threshold:float}. routing should be deterministic to avoid flapping.

sara: routing rule: prefer tenant pin if present. bundles are advisory except when owner-enabled. also add bundle_compatible_pools:list to indicate which hardware pools are interchangeable.

lucas: tenant opt-out needed: tenant_meta.allow_bundling:bool. for regulated tenants default is false.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary started for variant v2-int8 on release/2026-03-12 :rocket:

mike: deprecation lifecycle: phase=soft-bundle (grouped telemetry), notice (notify tenants + suggested_migration), hard-deprecate (reject/redirect). add deprecation_phase enum and deprecation_eta timestamp.

sara: audit must not be lossy: every inference audit line must include exact variant hash and bundle_id if used. UI shows both bundle and per-variant metrics.

kevin: implementational note: compute bundle_id deterministically (sha256 of sorted variant hashes + owner id) so replicas agree and backfill is reproducible.

yun: autoscaler: bundling could mask pool differences; require explicit bundle_compatible_pools and fallbacks when variant-pool mismatch occurs.

sara: next steps: i'll write a short RFC + data model PR with fields: bundle_id, bundle_window_days, bundle_policy, compatibility_signal, deprecation_phase, deprecation_eta, bundle_compatible_pools, suggested_migration, tenant_meta.allow_bundling. will include telemetry and rollback playbook. aiming for RFC this week.
